question: In a certain code language, if GLAZED is written as EDAZGL, then how will DAYOUT be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/317243f01abb54c49f01d1dd0b3f80b2dfcaf756dc029b0bd0a44e90ab6f5209.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 GLAZED is written as EDAZGL.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79b1989f5b358dea479ff97584d9a7a6840342323ac0a3dffc031322648ca0be.png] 

Similarly, 

**DAYOUT** = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc15534632af4a9f41583a41835021edf7add3292b754ef6749084efce23bf83.png] 

Hence, '**UTYODA**' is the correct answer.
